item.title: California voters reject billionaire tax
item.description:
California voters have rejected Proposition 40, a proposed one-time 5 percent tax on billionaires. 52.8 percent of voters opposed the measure, with 47.2 percent supporting it, according to The New York Times . Proposition 40 would have imposed a 5 percent tax on individuals who lived in the state on January 1, 2026, and whose net worth is over $1 billion as of December 31, 2026. Two competing ballot measures designed to cancel out the wealth tax, Propositions 41 and 42 , would restrict California's ability to impose wealth taxes. If either passes with more votes than Proposition 40, it will be nullified. Proposition 42, which prohibits new state taxes on personal property, is expected to pass. not only was california's wealth tax rejected by voters, the *concept* of the wealth tax was *banned* by voters. eat shit, communists. pic.twitter.com/1wCP01L01v — Mike Solana (@micsolana)…
